title: ymnY - it emitted
html:
Graph connections

Root

  • mny - decreeing

Meaning

it emitted · Lemma يُمْنَى

Surahs (3)

  • 053 An-Najm
  • 056 Al-Waqiah
  • 075 Al-Qiyamah

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali). Showing up to 10 verses.

53:46 · 053 An-Najm

مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

Word in this verse: تُمْنَىٰ — it is emitted

English (Sahih International): From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

English (Yusuf Ali): From a seed when lodged (in its place);

56:58 · 056 Al-Waqiah

أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

Word in this verse: تُمْنُونَ — you emit

English (Sahih International): Have you seen that which you emit?

English (Yusuf Ali): Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-

Open on Quran.com

75:37 · 075 Al-Qiyamah

أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ

Word in this verse: يُمْنَىٰ — emitted

English (Sahih International): Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

English (Yusuf Ali): Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
